info.name: LJVIS — XTR SOAP mõlemas suunas
info.description: Published XTR 0.5.0-rc: inbound SOAP provider and outbound JSON/SOAP loopback through real Ruuter/Resql. No skipped contract checks. Runs in tests/postman/run-all.sh (CI service xtr-inbound).

exec: // X-Road SOAP header as the Security Server would send it (client = test consumer).
pm.test('soap:address matches configured peer URL', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('soap:address location="' + pm.environment.get('xtr_inbound_url') + '/soap-in/ljvis/ljvis"'));

pm.test('All 6 LJVIS1 operations published', () => { const t = pm.response.text(); ['ErakorralineYVquery','ErakorralineYVconfirm','IsikuKontroll','IsikuEttevoteKontrollid','RegisterJobInspection','RegisterJobInspection_v2'].forEach(op => pm.expect(t).to.include('<wsdl:operation name="' + op + '"')); });

item.name: V2 cargo, no optional proceeding, false boolean
V2 invalid transport type → Client fault

exec: pm.test('Useful business validation error', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('SOAP-ENV:Client'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('kontrolli_tyyp must be S or V'); });

item.name: IsikuKontroll JSON → SOAP → LJVIS2 → SOAP → JSON

exec: pm.test('SOAP response decoded to JSON', () => { const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.response).to.have.property('request'); pm.expect(j.response).to.have.property('response'); });

pm.test('Request round-tripped without losing nested fields', () => { const expected=JSON.parse(pm.variables.replaceIn(pm.request.body.raw)).request; const actual=pm.response.json().response.request; function normal(v) { if(Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(normal); if(v && typeof v==='object') { const o={}; Object.keys(v).forEach(k=>o[k]=normal(v[k])); return o; } return String(v); } pm.expect(normal(actual)).to.deep.equal(normal(expected)); });

pm.test('Multiple records and real names survived both conversions', () => { const rows=pm.response.json().response.response.kontrollid.item; pm.expect(rows.length).to.be.at.least(2); pm.expect(rows.some(r=>r.soiduki_nimi==='Demo' && r.soiduki_perekonnanimi==='Test')).to.be.true; });
